name: application-candidate-pipeline-stage
title: Candidate Pipeline Stage
description: A single hiring-stage column with a candidate count badge, holding applicant cards that show avatar, role, source tag, and interview rating.
useWhen: Building an applicant tracking system (ATS) board where candidates move through hiring stages (Applied, Interview, Offer, Hired).
Each candidate card needs a role, sourcing channel, and (once interviewed) a rating, distinct from generic deal or task cards.
avoidWhen: The board is a sales/deal pipeline, not recruiting — use `Deal Pipeline Stage` for that domain's card fields (value, close date) instead.
You only need a single flat candidate list without stage grouping — a plain `details-list` or table communicates that more directly.
responsiveBehavior: The stage column keeps a fixed width with an internally scrollable card list; multiple stage columns should sit side by side in a horizontally scrollable board container.
accessibility: The stage header pairs a color dot with a text label ("Interview") and a numeric count badge, none of which is color-only information.
Each candidate card's source tag (Referral, LinkedIn, Applied) is rendered as text, not an icon-only badge.
The star rating is paired with a numeric value (e.g. "4.8") as text, not conveyed by star count alone.

variants.title: Interview stage
variants.description: An 'Interview' hiring-stage column (count badge: 4) with three candidate cards showing avatar, name, role, source tag, and a star rating for two already-interviewed candidates.
accessibility: Source tags and ratings are all rendered as text, not icon-only.

variants.title: Interview stage (Dark)
variants.description: Candidate pipeline stage adapted for dark surfaces, including card borders, tag backgrounds, and rating star color.
accessibility: Card text, tags, and ratings all meet WCAG AA contrast against the dark stage background.
